programme.desc: When intrepid reporter Tom Merrick discovers that the same man appears in photographs of major disasters over a hundred-year period, he embarks on an incredible action-filled race against time to prevent a series of new disasters.

programme.title: Gang of Roses
programme.desc: A gang of gold-hunting outlaws, headed by the ruthless Left Eye Watkins (Bobby Brown), takes over the peaceful town of Flatridge, tearing the sleepy outpost to shreds as they search for riches. They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew.

programme.title: Smothered
programme.desc: A food critic (Carly Pope) finds her life turned upside down when her uninhibited mother (Christine Baranski) arrives unannounced at Christmas. Desperate to offload her, she enlists the help of a chef (Bobby Cannavale) - with surprising results.

programme.title: Edison
programme.desc: Ambitious young reporter Pollack (Justin Timberlake) suspects insidious corruption in his town's elite police unit, known as F.R.A.T., and finds a friendly source in Deed (LL Cool J), a dissatisfied member of the squad. With Deed's information and the backing of his publisher, Ashford (Morgan Freeman), and a crusading lawyer, Wallace (Kevin Spacey), Pollack infiltrates the secretive police cabal. He finds himself in over his head, however, when he discovers the true extent of the criminality.

programme.title: End Game
programme.desc: When Secret Service agent Alex Thomas (Cuba Gooding Jr.) acts too slowly to stop a crazed shooter, the president of the United States (Jack Scalia) is brutally shot in the middle of a press conference. In the wake of his death, journalist Kate Crawford (Angie Harmon) begins to suspect a massive conspiracy is afoot. Crawford convinces a skeptical Thomas to help her, and the two struggle to unravel the mystery behind the assassination -- before they become the next targets.

programme.title: Reach Me
programme.desc: A motivational book written by a mysterious man inspires an unlikely group of people. Sylvester Stallone, Lauren Cohan, Cary Elwes and Terry Crews lead a star-studded cast.

programme.desc: A veteran thief recruits a younger crook to help him pull off one final job in order to repay his debt to the Russian mob.

programme.title: Accidental Love
programme.desc: In this star-studded rom-com starring Jessica Biel ("Next") and Jake Gyllenhaal, ("Nightcrawler") a small town waitress gets a nail accidentally lodged in her head, causing unpredictable behavior.

programme.desc: Jason Statham stars as a tough cop who's dispatched to take down a serial killer who has been targeting police officers. Also featuring Paddy Considine and Aidan Gillen.

programme.desc: A young woman pretends to be pregnant in order to avoid being fired from her job. When that gets her special treatment from everyone, she tries to keep up the lie for nine months.

programme.title: Borrowed Hearts
programme.desc: A single mother agrees to pose temporarily as the wife of her boss, who needs a wife to impress a tradition-loving industrialist. With Eric McCormack and Roma Downey.

programme.title: My Baby Gone
programme.desc: Pregnant Emily bonds quickly with her pregnant neighbor Kelly, but Kelly is faking it and plans to steal Emily's baby.

programme.title: Hard Cash
programme.desc: This fast-paced crime thriller stars Christian Slater and Val Kilmer. Released from prison, an infamous thief and his new crew pull off a brilliant robbery and become embroiled with a corrupt FBI agent when they discover the money is marked.

programme.title: Trespass
programme.desc: Fast-talking diamond dealer Kyle Miller (Nicolas Cage) and his wife, Sarah (Nicole Kidman), live the good life in a beautiful home surrounded by thick woods. Their dream life turns into a nightmare when violent thieves, led by Elias (Ben Mendelsohn), invade their home disguised as police officers. With Kyle and Sarah now frightened captives, Kyle knows he must use every negotiating trick in his book, for once Elias and his men get what they want, the Millers will likely be killed.

programme.title: Plato's Run
programme.desc: Hired to rescue escaped inmates, Plato (Gary Busey, "The Buddy Holly Story") is framed for a Cuban gangster's assassination. With Roy Scheider ("Jaws") and Steven Bauer ("Scarface").

programme.title: Cold Blood
programme.desc: A legendary retired hit man (Jean Reno) lives in isolation in the barren North American wilderness. When he rescues a woman from a snowmobiling accident, he soon discovers that she's harboring a secret that forces him to return to his lethal ways.

programme.title: Christmas with a Prince: Becoming Royal
programme.desc: Tasha goes to St. Savarre to spend Christmas with Prince Alex. After a proposal, a royal wedding is underway.

programme.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
programme.desc: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: Mercenary for Justice
programme.desc: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag.

programme.sub-title: Stroking Our Favorite Big Blocks (and One Small Block) For More Power

programme.title: Truck Tech
programme.desc: After months of prep, the '89 Blazer hits the paint booth for a custom mix of color. And to accompany the panels will be a color-matched bedliner.

programme.sub-title: Chevy C-10 - Part 1: Auto Cross Pretender

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: Our Jeep TrashHawk gets the upgraded axles, brakes, and suspension it will need to handle 707 horses, and become a ride like its never been before.
programme.sub-title: Upgrading The '86 Wagoneer Suspension to Handle 785 Horsepower

programme.title: Detroit Muscle

programme.sub-title: Hellcat Dodge Charger Hits the Road

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: Starting with a bare block, we build a piece of big modern Mopar muscle! Complete with a Holley High-Ram Intake and Terminator X Max Fuel Injection, we get a big jump in power that's dyno proven!
programme.sub-title: Building Up a New 6.4L Gen III HEMI For Reliable Muscle Car Power

programme.title: Carcass
programme.desc: Our '96 Chevy Silverado gets new body parts. Plus we'll prep it for paint and show you how we are restoring the original color before hitting the road.
programme.sub-title: Restoring The Abandoned Chevy Silverado Paint Back To Its Former Glory

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: The transformation continues on this clean '85 K-10 square body. We remove the cab and axles, then tear it down to the bare chassis. We'll unveil some exciting upgrades to give this '80s TV show knockoff a modern day appeal.
programme.sub-title: Faux Guy Square Body Gets 1-Ton Dana 60 Axles

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: From stock to rock, Tommy and Marc introduce the EBC Brakes Mustang GT Giveaway Car and give it more power!
programme.sub-title: Adding 315HP to a 2016 Mustang GT with a Stage 2 Supercharger

programme.title: Carcass

programme.sub-title: Artistry In Motion - Project UnSanctioned Part 5

programme.title: Carcass
programme.desc: We start the reassembly of our '78 Postal Jeep, "Junk Mail" with new gears and lockers for our axles. Plus, we drop in our upgraded drivetrain with a 4 to 1 transfer case.
programme.sub-title: Time To Roll! Installing New Gears, Lockers and Drivetrain in Our DJ5 Jeep

programme.title: MuscleCar

programme.sub-title: Test Driving a 1970 Camaro RS/SS Tribute Build

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: We add a body kit and a wrap to our EBC Brakes giveaway Mustang plus, Tommy and Marc bring back the Hellcat '69 Charger.
programme.sub-title: Modding a Mustang GT for an Aggressive Look

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: Helping a viewer it's time to breath some life into a 1979 Ford F100. From spark to fuel we find some problems and we've got some solutions to get his ride back on the road!
programme.sub-title: Driveway Rescue: Help for a '79 F100

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: The guys take a test spin in the Valvoline Giveaway Camaro, and swing by the last remaining drag strip in England for a day of hot passes.
programme.sub-title: Camaro Test Drive and English Drag Racing

programme.desc: Our '78 Postal Jeep gets an upgraded suspension that can handle the trails. We'll start by fabricating our axles and frame for a 4 link setup.

programme.desc: Our 1993 Dodge Ram Dually is back in the shop to have its final dress rehearsal. The guys give you some pointers when measuring for custom driveshafts. Then we clockout and take Nightshift on it's maiden voyage.

programme.desc: Complete coverage of the second annual LS Fest West from Las Vegas Motor Speedway!

programme.title: Music City Trucks

programme.title: Engine Power

programme.desc: LT & Austin purchase a 2011 Sierra Denali HD, plus they are on the road in Indy for coverage of the Ultimate Callout Challenge.

programme.desc: Tommy and Peyton get to work on their 1990 Mustang. They install a new front and rear suspension in Project Fast Lane Fox Body to handle its new engine.

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: 'The Valvoline Sweepstakes Camaro is completed and readied to be given to a lucky viewer.

programme.title: Truck Tech
programme.desc: The men hit the road to rescue a viewer's ex-border patrol Bronco with new exterior & interior goodies. Plus custom exhaust for our Klassy K5 Blazer

programme.title: Music City Trucks

programme.sub-title: Stock To Stacked: Bumper, Tire, and Suspension Upgrades To A 2021 Bronco

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: We bring you straightforward information and tips to make your next engine build go quicker and easier!

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Our 1969 Pontiac GTO, Project Henchman, needs to bulk up before breaking out, so Tommy and Peyton are using the time to modify the chassis and install new fuel lines on this tough prisoner.

programme.title: Meet the Meerkats
programme.desc: Meerkats live in close families and rely on their companions to watch their backs. In their vast and unforgiving home of the Namib desert, only together can they defeat the odds stacked against them. One young female is forced from her group, overcoming a brutal attack from the alpha pair and fearing for her life. Cast out and left to fend for herself, she has no choice but to roam the desert and find a way to live.

programme.title: Meet the Mustelids
programme.desc: To many ears the name mustelid might sound mysterious and confusing. They may sound strange, but this family of hunters are probably much more familiar than you think. They're tiny terrors; ankle-height tigers of the undergrowth. From the icy northern climbs where the bold wolverine quietly rules the forests, scattering wolves with a fearsome glance, to the sun-drenched wetlands of the Amazon where man-sized giant otters work together to protect their families and defend their homes.

programme.title: Hawaii: Paradise in the Pacific
programme.desc: In episode two we take a look at Maui and Moloka'i. In the middle of the archipelago they form the heart of Hawaii. The second largest island of Hawai'i - Maui - is a true paradise for surfers. Archie Kalepa was one of the first big wave surfers and is still chasing the thrill today. The ukulele represents the sound of the islands like no other instrument. Eric Devine has been building the plucked string instrument for 20 years. In Kula he goes in search of the perfect wood.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Argentina
programme.desc: Argentina's northern territory contains one of the largest reserves in the country. Iberá is a vast expanse of swamps, marshes and lagoons, with a biodiversity count to rival the Pantanal. These lands are bursting with life, home to over 4000 animal and plant species. The rainy season in Iberá finds the wetlands in bloom... but unseen perils lurk beneath the surface, and even here, life can be a struggle for survival.

programme.title: Cost of Progress
programme.desc: The natural world is in crisis. For years humanity has exploited the planet's resources, and the creatures that live here. Growth and innovation can be a marvelous thing, but at what cost to our one and only planet? When we continue to push ahead blindly, it's more often than not Mother Nature that pays the price. Now it is time for us to rally - to take heed and start to turn back the tide. It's time for us to recognize our part in this crisis and redress the balance of the cost of progress.

programme.title: Meet the Pigs
programme.desc: What first comes to mind when you think of pigs? Mud wallows and pink, curly tails? Perhaps lucky symbols and money banks, or maybe just bacon sandwiches? Whatever it is, you're probably underestimating the world's amazing collection of pigs. Today they might be one of our favourite farm animals, but if we visit their cousins in the wild we start to reveal the unique and wonderful world of the pig.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: The masters of the sky are the winged predators of the aerial world. Whether swooping from altitude at phenomenal speed to strike an unsuspecting target from above, flicking and darting between trees in a lethal tail chase, or ghos-ting silently through the night in pursuit of prey, they excite our admiration and inspire awe in equal measure. All are superbly adapted to hunting and masters of their position at the top of the food chain.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: Lakes and rivers are created by streams high in the mountains. Fresh water springs, rain drawn up as moisture from the oceans, and melting snow all ebb, rush and flow down into our rivers and streams. Streams, rivers and lakes are home to countless animal species. A wide variety of species from insects, to amphibians, repti-les, fish, birds and even mammals are found in rivers, lakes and streams all around the world.

programme.title: Wildest Places: Pacific
programme.desc: Wildest Places explores some of the most incredible natural habitats on earth & a diverse range of wildlife.

programme.title: Hannah Goes to Namibia
programme.desc: Hannah Emde meets the most famous big cat researcher in the world. Dr. Laurie Marker is the founder of the Cheetah Conservation Fund (CCF), which has set the global benchmark for cheetah conservation. Hannah spends a day at the CCF center near Otjivarongo, gets very close to the big cats in the enclosure and is impressed by the simple, but effective concept of protecting these animals.

programme.title: February (Nature's Calendar)
programme.desc: In the northern hemisphere February is one of the toughest months of the year, the seemingly unending cold and scarce food of winter. Some animals fail, but their bodies become a bounty that will see carnivores and scavengers through. In parts of Africa animals face the opposite problem, high temperatures and overdue rains and must trek to find food and water. While the Amazon has the opposite problem, too much water, with the rainforest wildlife having to adapt to a submerged forest.

programme.title: Hidden Spain
programme.desc: Spain is found at the crossroads between the Mediterranean and the Atlantic, resulting in diverse landscapes, ancient cultures and magnificent wildlife.

programme.title: Hidden Germany
programme.desc: A dramatic country steeped in history and ancient culture, it's easy to focus on Germany's great cities and landmarks. But Germany also has a more hidden treasure-trove, one full of natural wonders

programme.title: Hidden Spain
programme.desc: Spain is found at the crossroads between the Mediterranean and the Atlantic, resulting in diverse landscapes, ancient cultures and magnificent wildlife.

programme.title: Coasts - Rolling with the Waves
programme.desc: We love our coasts, and so do animals! The corridor of water where the open ocean transitions into coastal habitat is known as the surf zone. The churning forces of the waves clashing with the land make these some of the most food-rich waters on Earth. Nutrients are both washed off the coast from rain and rivers, but also pushed up from the depths thanks to waves and currents.

programme.title: The Enchanted Forest
programme.desc: To spend a day in the forest, from dawn to dusk, is to bathe in nature. There's enchantment at every turn. Throughout the day the cast of characters in the forest changes, from foraging bears to playing fox cubs, dashing hummingbirds and dancing butterflies. But it's as twilight descends, that the most enchanting side of the forest is revealed. Time to watch a firework display curtesy of fireflies. They are the real magicians of the enchanted forest.

programme.title: Secret Life of Baby Owls
programme.desc: Owls - with their huge eyes, flat faces and distinctive hoot - they are truly iconic!creatures. But how much do we really know about these mysterious nocturnal birds? We're about to find out as we follow the fate of new born baby owls as they grow up and learn to fly.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Europe
programme.desc: Over the last million years, our planet suffered a series of major ice-ages. Much of the northern hemisphere was covered in ice sheets several kilometres thick and creatures had no choice but to adapt or die. Over time, temperatures rose, causing these glaciers to retreat, however, in certain parts of Europe the ice-age never left. For many creatures, the struggle to survive 'a life below zero' continues.

programme.title: Migrations - Herds on the Move
programme.desc: Whether driven by the search for food or the simple will to survive, great herd migrations are some of the most spectacular events of the natural world.

programme.title: Creepy Crawlies - Army
programme.desc: Few creatures have the complex levels of regimented society as the social insects; these creatures understand that the strength of the individual is nothing compared with the combined power of the group. Creepy crawlies can form armies to help them build elaborate homes, raise their young and hunt their prey. These incredible communities both plagues our nightmares and fuels our imaginations. Society is considered the realm of higher beings, but hidden amongst the foliage, an army is rising.

programme.title: Fight for Territory
programme.desc: Biological instinct is driven by three things: the desire to stay alive, to find food and to breed. But to do all these things, animals first need a home. Out in the wilderness a safe place to call home can be the difference between life and death. A place to secure meals, raise their families and hide from danger. Ideal spots are in short supply and well worth fighting for!

programme.title: February (Nature's Calendar)
programme.desc: In the northern hemisphere February is one of the toughest months of the year, the seemingly unending cold and scarce food of winter. Some animals fail, but their bodies become a bounty that will see carnivores and scavengers through. In parts of Africa animals face the opposite problem, high temperatures and overdue rains and must trek to find food and water. While the Amazon has the opposite problem, too much water, with the rainforest wildlife having to adapt to a submerged forest.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Islands
programme.desc: The Falkland Islands' pristine coastlines and bountiful seas offer a lifeline and breeding centre for millions of penguins each year. Though while some find sanctuary on dry land, there's a daily battle to survive in the waters which surround these wild and rocky shores.

programme.title: Hidden Germany
programme.desc: A dramatic country steeped in history and ancient culture, it's easy to focus on Germany's great cities and landmarks. But Germany also has a more hidden treasure-trove, one full of natural wonders

programme.title: Owls - Masters of the Night
programme.desc: Owls are mysterious creatures, living in a twilight world that we can rarely visit. Many cultures, including the Romans, Mayans and Aztecs, saw owls as something to fear, symbols of bad luck and impending doom. In reality owls are highly resourceful birds that have carved out a niche and a unique way to live. They range in size from smaller than a pigeon to as large as an eagle. They've colonised terrains from tundra to rainforest.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Desert Lands of the Middle East
programme.desc: Turkey sits on a jumbled collection of tectonic plates, whose collisions have created a tortuous landscape. In fact 80% of Turkeys terrain is rough, broken and mountainous. Mountain ranges both collect and block weather systems, affecting the climate across the country and producing huge contrasts between and within differing habitats.

programme.title: Wild Uruguay
programme.desc: Uruguay's biodiversity is surprisingly greater than one would expect. We will find out why as we embark on a journey through its ecosystems and landscapes to discover its fauna. Today we know that Uruguay is more than just the outermost edge of the Pampas, as the country holds a range of ecosystems. Within its borders, species of the Pampas come face to face with species of the Atlantic Forest, the Misiones rainforest, and the Chaco forest, giving rise to unexpected encounters.

programme.title: Polar Bear Family
programme.desc: We have a complex relationship with polar bears. One of the most loved creatures in the world, we see them as cute and funny but at the same time as dangerous top predators. One of the few that might actually hunt us. They are the ultimate icons of polar wilderness and have become figureheads for climate change and conservation. One thing is for sure, the lives of polar bears are nothing short of remarkable.

programme.title: The Power Of Plants - Race to Grow and Breed
programme.desc: Just like animals, the lives of plants are dominated by the need to become strong and pass on genes to the next generation - a race to grow and breed. They must race to beat their competition to the best light spots, and to make the most of perilously short seasons. And also like in the animal kingdom, different species have developed a near unending list of strategies to ensure their legacy is passed on.

programme.title: Wildest Survival
programme.desc: In this episode we explore why and how animals fight and reveal the ways in which they are programmed to survive at all costs. Most animals will defend themselves against predators, but many also do battle with members of the same species. Animals fight for two main reasons: for a mate or to defend their young or territory. And when animals fight, it can often be to the death.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Europe
programme.desc: Europe was once covered by forest, from the Arctic Ocean to the Mediterranean Sea. Wiped out in a mini ice age around 15000 years ago, they, and the wildlife that inhabit them are making a spectacular recovery. Today, Europe's forests cover around 1 000 million hectares (about 30 times the size of Poland).

programme.title: Wildest Places: Antarctic
programme.desc: Wildest Places explores some of the most incredible natural habitats on earth & a diverse range of wildlife.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: Islands come in all shapes and sizes all over the world. Any land mass surrounded by water is an island. They are found in seas, oceans lakes and rivers. Atolls, Islets, keys or cays are formed either as result of land brea-king away, water encroaching on the land, or by volcanic eruptions on the sea bed . Islands are often isolated, which leads to the development of a unique flora, fauna and wildlife. The environmental eco-structure of islands differs widely, as does the wildlife.

programme.title: Wild Indochinas - Wild heart
programme.desc: Indochina; three ancient kingdoms, Laos, Vietnam and Cambodia, linked by one great river: the mighty Mekong. A mystical land shaped by the forces of the monsoon. A region ravaged by war but, like a Phoenix, risen from the ashes. Within its boundaries can be found one tenth of the world's species, and some of the richest ecosystems on the planet. This is the land of the Mother River, one of the most bio diverse regions on Earth.

programme.title: Seals - Clowns of the Sea
programme.desc: Much loved clowns of the sea, seals are endlessly fascinating. Even though they're not much more than bloated sausages on land, they're agile hunters and supremely graceful in the water. They en-tertain us with dramatic courtships, an endlessly playful sense of curiosity and some of the cutest babies on the planet.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: Te Moananui a Toi/ The Hauraki Gulf lies on the doorstep of New Zealand's largest city. Every summer millions of visitors from the tropics converge here, all lured by a unique seasonal smorgasbord. Giant oceanic manta rays, rarely filmed in these waters, glide into the gulf. Bryde's whales are also primed for the feasting season, alongside common dolphins, and bronze whaler sharks. In the sky above rare black petrels stalk the dolphins to survive.
programme.sub-title: Te Moananui a Toi/ The Hauraki Gulf

programme.title: Animals of the Bible
programme.desc: The bible is one of the most famous texts on earth. But it doesn't just concern humans, it also mentions animals - and some of these are probably not what you'd expect. We've all heard of the ox and the ass, the donkey that carried Mary, but did you know gazelles are mentioned in the bible? Or that great whales, cunning leopards and even the energetic hyrax feature?

programme.title: Secret Life of Baby Owls
programme.desc: Owls - with their huge eyes, flat faces and distinctive hoot - they are truly iconic!creatures. But how much do we really know about these mysterious nocturnal birds? We're about to find out as we follow the fate of new born baby owls as they grow up and learn to fly.

programme.title: Hunters of the Forest
programme.desc: Forests are dark, shady habitats, realms of shadows perfect for predators to lurk. The dense plant growth facilitates a wealth of prey species, and cunning predators of all shapes and sizes have adapted to exploit every niche. Whether crawling on the forest floor, gliding through the trees or stalking the shadows in between, hunters have mastered the terrain in every type of forest imagina-ble.

programme.title: Hannah Goes to Namibia
programme.desc: Hannah Emde meets the most famous big cat researcher in the world. Dr. Laurie Marker is the founder of the Cheetah Conservation Fund (CCF), which has set the global benchmark for cheetah conservation. Hannah spends a day at the CCF center near Otjivarongo, gets very close to the big cats in the enclosure and is impressed by the simple, but effective concept of protecting these animals.

programme.title: Wildest Islands
programme.desc: Between the continents of North and South America is a tropical paradise: the Caribbean. This archipelago of over 7,000 islands and reefs lies within the crystal clear waters of the Caribbean Sea. From just a few metres wide, to hundreds of kilometres across, every island is different, and each has its own unique wildlife.
programme.sub-title: The Caribbean: The Wild Side of Paradise

programme.title: Animal Record Breakers
programme.desc: We love to measure aspects of life at its extremes. The biggest, the tallest, heaviest, fastest, slowest - even the rarest. The creatures that hold the records for these categories are some of the most interesting in the natural world. Some are familiar and iconic, but it's also important to recognise some of the more surprising record breakers. These quirky and unusual animals that often go ignored are inventive, ingenious and awe-inspiring.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: Alaska one of the last true wildernesses on earth. With 600 square miles of pristine habitat this state is home to an abundance of wildlife. Herds of caribou roam the plains, wolves stalk in the forest and the brown bears are the kings of the rivers. But you don't always have to head to the wild to come face to face with an animal. In the city of Anchorage the wildlife is a lot closer than you think, because a city with so much green space means everywhere is fair game for its wild neighbours.

programme.title: Hidden Japan
programme.desc: The culture of Japan is incredible. But there are also more than 130 mammals and 600 bird species dwelling in Japan's 6,852 islands.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: This city spends most of the year encased in ice...but when summer hits, Anchorage bursts into life. Animals and plants living this far north have been forced to adapt, working faster to make the most of the short season, but these animals built to withstand Alaska's extreme winters, often struggle in Anchorage's summer heat! Temperatures can be surprisingly high, with average July highs of 26 degrees C. 300,000 people live alongside these wild animals in the ever growing city of Anchorage.

programme.title: Wildest Islands
programme.desc: Situated 1,000km west of Ecuador in South America, the Galapagos archipelago contains 13 main islands and a hundred or so smaller rocks and reefs. The region's wilderness is so pristine and rich in life it altered our entire view of the natural world. It was the Galapagos islands' finches and mockingbirds that proved key to Darwin's theory of evolution.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: Anchorage is home to hundreds of black bears. And it's these black bears, that are patrolling the city. With their brains, their brawn and their cunning, these bears have mastered life in this urban jungle. When Spring arrives the bears hit the city as it's time to start eating. And these bears have found a source of food that is much easier to catch than a slippery salmon - it's trash. And it is everywhere. The city's bins and dumpsters have become the perfect bear restaurant.

programme.title: Hawaii: Paradise in the Pacific
programme.desc: In epsiode one we take a look at Kaua'i - the oldest island in the archipelago. Kaua'i's isolation for thousands of years led to an increased rate of evolution. In a relatively short time, new species are formed here, many animals and plants can only be found here. But they are in danger. On the shield volcano Waiʻaleʻale - the rainiest place on earth, scientists like Lukas Behnke are fighting for the preservation of endangered native animals and plants.

programme.title: Marine Mammals - Born to Swim
programme.desc: Every year some 15 million of us around the world cram onto little boats and head out onto the ocean, hoping for the encounter of a lifetime. For centuries whales and dolphins seem to have reached out to us, capturing our imaginations and our souls. Despite their popularity, much of their lives remain a mystery, taking place beneath the waves and beyond our reach.

programme.title: Aging in the Wild
programme.desc: Salmon, Bears, Beluga Whales, Naked Mole Rat, Bacteria, Aspen Trees In this episode, we explore how different animal species react to impending death. We explore the factors that lead animals to their final resting places: disease, injury, predation, drought, famine. Some species, such as the naked mole rat, while not immortal, seem to be able to effectively protect themselves from certain diseases such as cancer.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: It's a miracle the first seafarers ever found the Cook Islands/ Kūki 'Airani scattered across two million square kilometres of the Pacific Ocean. But every year, these tropical islands become the destination for over three thousand Humpback whales who've undertaken one of the longest migrations on the planet. They come here to socialise, mate, and raise their young.

programme.title: Aquarium: An Aquatic Life
programme.desc: This episode will introduce you to some of the Aquariums most weird and wonderful inhabitants. From upside-down Jellyfish to male Seahorses giving birth, these wacky residents make up the enchanting world that keeps guests coming to through the Aquarium doors! But other pressing issues keep the staff busy, from keeping the peace between man and seal, to preparing a new gigantic predator tank, there's not a minute to rest in the life of an Aquarist!

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: Unsealed: Conspiracy Files looks at some of the secret government warehouses of the United States. It looks at Fort Knox gold depository and asks whether the gold there has been removed. It also examines Hangar 18 at Wright Patterson Air Force base in Ohio and whether it contains crashed alien craft or the Nazi Die Glocke.

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: Unsealed: Conspiracy Files examines a conspiracy that may be seeking to eradicate 90% of the world's population. It looks at the Georgia Guidestones built by an unknown architect which call for humanity to reduce its population to below 500 million.

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: Unsealed: Conspiracy Files examines whether the United State military has constructed flying saucers. It looks at unclassified documents describing Project 1794 and a supersonic large disk fighter aircraft. These plans are later developed by a Canadian company Avro Aircraft into the Avrocar.

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: Some places in the world, record more UAP sightings than the rest. So many so, in fact, that people flock from all over the world just for the chance to glimpse a flying saucer.

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: As the Fermi Paradox states, the possibilities that there is advanced life in the universe is surprisingly high. And if the universe is so old, why haven't we had any contact with extraterrestrial life?

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: There is physical evidence of alien activity that has been hidden from the public for years. It is starting to be revealed.

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: It is likely that aliens exist in a universe as large as ours. How would they navigate those vast distances and potentially visit us on earth?

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: There are three types of close encounters, sightings, fleeting interactions, aliens taking humans for extended periods. We meet real people who have experienced alien life up close.

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: Several US presidents throughout history have described encounters with UAPs. Is there already an agreement in place between our world leaders and intelligent alien life? And if so, who is keeping that information from the public and why?

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: In 1998 Astronauts captured images of a satellite in Earth's orbit. Is it the same alien object that Nicola Tesla detected in 1899, an alien probe known as the Black Knight? And in 2017 scientists discovered another mysterious satellite from outside our solar system. What could explain Oumuamua's artificial trajectory?

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: Mars is the key focus of humanity's expansion into space right now. Millions of years ago the Red Planet had a lot in common with Earth, but it's now a desert wasteland. Do the doorways recently discovered on the planet's surface lead to an existential lesson for our species?

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: According to physics, time travel is possible. So could it be that UAPs aren't coming from somewhere else, but from some when else. Could these UAPs be us, from the future?

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: Between 1981 and 2011, NASA's Space Shuttles flew 135 missions. The Space Shuttle cameras, manned and unmanned, have recorded astounding footage of UFOs that many experts find almost impossible to explain.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: The flying saucer. For decades it's been synonymous with UFO terror. But millions of reported encounters tell a very different story. From Cold War showdowns to telepathic terrors, join is as we track the rise of Black Triangles.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: Close encounters. There's no telling where or when they will happen. But of all the possible scenarios, none is more terrifying than the one we're unaware of - until it's too late.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: Is Britain facing an alien invasion? Does it know more than it's saying? And is it really dedicated to protecting its citizens? Or is it only protecting itself. From military cover-ups, to dire warnings from government insiders we unseal the explosive secrets of the real British X-Files.

programme.title: The British UFO Files
programme.desc: The British UFO Files tells a story more bizarre than anything to be found within the pages of even the fictional X Files. Featuring eye-witness accounts by top ranking military personnel, previously top secret documentation and rare archive footage, the film examines information ranging from the alleged production of Nazi UFOs to the landing of an alien spacecraft at a British air-force base.

programme.title: UFO Casebook
programme.desc: The incredible UFO footage documented by Antonio Urzi has startled researchers all over the World. Nobody had ever seen such clean and plentiful material on UFO's. Researchers have since revealed them to be real objects of different dimensions. But do we finally have enough proof that we are being visited by creatures of the cosmos? Interviews with Urzi and others involved are discussed.
programme.sub-title: The Urzi Case: Research and Analysis

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: For decades, scientists have been searching for proof that extraterrestrials exist. But just where does alien life exist? And what does it look like? Join us as we investigate just how close we are to First Contact.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: A mysterious book, 'The Blue Planet Project' has surfaced, outlining decades of cooperation between the U.S. military and alien forces on earth as well as a massive government cover-up to hide these visitors from the world.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: When citizens of Los Angeles started witnessing UFO's, they weren't entirely surprised. After all, this had happened before, in 1942. But why do so many UFO events take place in LA? The reason just might be right under our noses...and underwater.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: Could one of the most sacred place on Earth also house secret knowledge of extraterrestrial life? The path to disclosure just might lie on holy ground: at the Vatican.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: Tampered space photos, missing NASA recordings and a race to the moon all point to one very likely possibility: alien life exists, and our universe is anything but our own.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: Since the dawn of man, unexplained illnesses have attacked the human population with a vengeance. Are these diseases the result of a secret alien agenda to take over Planet Earth? Tonight, we unseal the truth behind these Alien Plagues.

programme.title: The Past Hunters: Enter the Paranormal
programme.desc: The Hack Green Secret Nuclear Bunker is a former government-owned nuclear bunker located at Hack Green, Cheshire, England. It Started as a decoy site for enemy bombers but later developed into a legitimate base. Now it is ripe with hauntings.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Flying Solo
programme.desc: Sean heads to Middleton, Manchester to investigate claims that a sad cavalier named Edward is haunting this location. Ring O Bells has also been used for druid rituals. Will he be able to summon any spirits tonight?
programme.sub-title: Haunting of The Sad Cavalier at The Ring O Bells - Part 1

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: The Ghost Dimension team travel back in time to The Galleries of Justice in Nottingham. This was a one stop shop for justice where criminals were held awaiting trial and should they be found guilty and sentenced to death they would be taken to the waiting gallows and hung. Do the spirits of the condemned still languish within the cells, afraid to move on to their final judgement?
programme.sub-title: Final Session at Galleries of Justice

programme.title: Paranormal Captured
programme.desc: The White Swan pub and hotel in Henley in Arden in the UK is reported to be a haunted hotspot. This former jailhouse with gallows has a gruesome history and owners Maria and Nigel believe a lady of the night who died in mysterious circumstances still roams the corridors.

programme.title: Paranormal Files: Extraordinary Stories - Ordinary People
programme.desc: Bonnybridge, a village in Scotland, has long been shrouded in paranormal mystery. Are the flying objects hovering above its skies connected to alien life? Explore the mystery in this episode.

programme.title: Paranormal Files: Extraordinary Stories - Ordinary People
programme.desc: Chris Martin is a British man who has spent his life collecting footage of suspected alien sightings. Martin shares his insights on UFO phenomena in this episode.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: Bex and Sean head to Sefton and investigate a police station connected to the murderous Jack The Ripper. Was James Maybrick really the Ripper? Did his wife poison him? Is he haunting this old police station? These are the questions Ghost Dimension investigate tonight.

programme.title: The Diary Of Jack The Ripper
programme.desc: Step by painstaking step, the diary is analyzed, verified, and questioned; experts pit their knowledge against the information in the diary; gradually and remorselessly the evidence against Maybrick mounts - until his identity is beyond reasonable doubt. Was Maybrick Jack The Ripper? A complete history of the chilling JTR murders with graphic photos, sickening details and documented evidence.

programme.title: The SS and The Occult
programme.desc: This powerful film revisits the sites most closely associated with Heinrich Himmler and traces the development of his warped ideology. Heinrich Himmler was the creator of the infamous Gestapo, the Waffen SS and the concentration camp network. He was inspired by mystic visions, runes, horoscopes and a longing for a heroic German past. The occult roots of the Third Reich are discussed.

programme.title: The Real Merlin
programme.desc: His name conjures up images of a golden age of magic, mystery and chivalry. Of Camelot and the search for the Holy Grail, King Arthur and his Knights of the Round Table. But is there any truth behind the myth of Merlin, a man beyond the legend? The Real Merlin finds a sixth-century druid, shaman and right-hand man to the last pagan king, a prophet who predicted his own strange three-fold death.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
programme.desc: According to a poll conducted by The Roper Organization in 1992, 3.7 million Americans could have been alien abductees. Richard interviews two supposed alien abductees about their claims they were on an alien space craft. He'll also speak with a top abduction researcher who has worked with over a hundred of abductees. However, a skeptic gives a greedier explanation for the abduction phenomenon.

programme.title: EXtraterrestrials: They are Among Us
programme.desc: From the Canary Islands to Galicia, passing through Catalonia, in very special places such as the Cañadas del Teide or on the mountain of Montserrat, witnesses and those contacted assure that UFOs have been making appearances for decades; and they claim to have proof of it!

programme.title: EXtraterrestrials: They are Among Us
programme.desc: These attacks are the most terrifying part of the phenomenon, and therefore, the most real. Attacks in the middle of the morning, like what happened with Nicolás Sánchez Martín, in Cáceres, or Joan Turu and José Félix Rodríguez, better known as the suicide bombers of Tarrasa, can lead to the death of the witnesses. What is behind these aggressive apparitions?

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: Some experts believe many atmospheric light shows are actually caused by extraterrestrials. Do they pose an imminent threat to humanity? Join us as the alien secrets behind atmospheric anomalies.

programme.title: Murder Maps
programme.desc: Nineteenth-century serial killer Mary Ann Cotton, aka the Black Widow, travels around northeast England and murders men for their life insurance.

programme.title: Conmen Case Files
programme.desc: Golightly conned tens of thousands of dollars from men she found in lonely hearts columns and dating sites.
programme.sub-title: Emma Golightly - Lonely Hearts Con Woman

programme.title: The Interrogation Room Hosted by Vivica A. Fox
programme.desc: Vivica examines the interrogation tapes connected to the violent axe murder of 57-year-old Denise Hallowell, who was discovered by her 17-year-old adopted son in her room with an axe embedded in her skull.

programme.title: Crimes Uncovered
programme.desc: On the eve of her 21st birthday, Leigh Matthews is kidnapped from her college campus and held for ransom by an unknown assailant.
programme.sub-title: A Family's Nightmare Begins: The Leigh Matthews Story Part 1

programme.title: Becoming Evil: Secret Language of Serial Killers
programme.desc: Talk about body language. See how serial killers like the Night Stalker use their victims as just another way to get their message out to the world.

programme.title: The Real Manhunter
programme.desc: In 1999, Maureen Hale vanished without a trace, leaving her husband and children behind.

programme.title: The Real Manhunter
programme.desc: Nimpha Ong and Ahmed Al-Haddad were tenants of 92-year-old Bridget 'Bridie' Skehan, a wealthy former socialite, at her Bayswater flat when they brutally beat Bridget to death in a gratuitously savage

programme.title: Nurses Who Kill
programme.desc: Wettlaufer, 49, of Ontario, intentionally administered fatal doses of drugs to her victims, aged 75 to 96, between 2007 and 2014. After killing, she would post some of her dozens of verses on the Allpoetry.com website. Wettlaufer's victims included five women and three men - all of whom were patients at Caressant Care nursing homes in Ontario, where Wettlaufer had worked.

programme.title: Nurses Who Kill
programme.desc: Vickie Dawn Jackson was described as sweet and 'gone to fat' by locals in her small Texas town. Why did Vickie kill off the friends and relatives of those who she knew in Nocona, Texas? Texas journalist Skip Hollandsworth spent time with Nurse Jackson at her Texas jail and reveals the truth about a remarkable, and evil, woman.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Firefighters in Barbizieux, Charente are called to a fire at a large house in the village; they arrive to find the lifeless body of the owner, 83-year-old Claude Tavernier lying in a large pool of blood.

programme.title: US Bounty Hunters
programme.desc: This mom didn't hold back on giving us the info we needed for her son...we follow him home and Fred and Mark chase him down on foot.

programme.title: US Bounty Hunters
programme.desc: Big Bad Bounty Hunter Fred tries to keep his look going by jumping the tall fence too!

programme.title: Deadly Standoffs
programme.desc: The Waco siege, a 51-day standoff involving the Branch Davidians in 1993, left nearly 80 people dead.

programme.title: 72 Hours: True Crime
programme.desc: A single mother in Saskatchewan visits a hospital in the midst of a panic attack.

programme.title: 72 Hours: True Crime
programme.desc: In 1981 Toronto, a model is reported dead at home by someone saying that they are the superintendent of the apartment block.

programme.title: Inside Crime Scene
programme.desc: In 2005, Liu Hong Mei's lover chopped up her body into seven parts; in 1989, body of a teenager was found with her head found a metre away from the rest of the body; can modern CSI and forensics techniques piece together to tell a crime process?

programme.title: Autopsy: The Last Hours of...
programme.desc: On March 31, 1993, 28-year-old Brandon Lee, son of kung fu legend Bruce Lee, was fatally shot on a film set; exploring how an accident like this could happen when the gun that fired the fatal shot was supposedly loaded with blank ammunition.

programme.title: Crimes Uncovered
programme.desc: Shot to death in their home, renowned doctor Anwar Kadwa and his wife Munirah's deaths leave a multitude of questions, who was responsible and what was their motive?
programme.sub-title: Flesh and Blood: The Riaz Kadwa Story

programme.title: World's Most Evil Killers
programme.desc: A profile into the murderer who terrorised the gay community as the 'Trash Bag Killer' and confessed to killing 32 victims.

programme.title: Child Snatchers
programme.desc: Belinda gets a lead about where her ex-husband is hiding their son in Turkey; Katherine tries to trace her son.

programme.title: Child Snatchers
programme.desc: Katherine's search for Luca is helped by technology.

programme.title: True Crime Nation with Chris Hansen
programme.desc: Host Chris Hansen and our talented team of veteran crime producers bring you a closer look at the crimes affecting our nation.

programme.title: Becoming Evil: Cult of Personality
programme.desc: Homosexual Serial Killers - John Wayne Gacy and the Highway Killers. Serial killing's homoerotic aspect is revealed though the grisly exploits of the clown killer, John Wayne Gacy, Atlanta's child killer, Wayne Williams, and the highway killers, William Bonin and Randy Kraft
programme.sub-title: John Wayne Gacy and the Highway Killers

programme.title: Crime Time Solvers
programme.desc: The disappearance of Marie-Hélène Di Francesca cast a pall of fear over the tranquil streets of Mouscron.

programme.title: Crime Stories
programme.desc: A common-law couple was found guilty of the 1990 rape and murder of Taunja Bennett near Portland, Oregon. However, a letter signed with a happy face sent to a Portland newspaper claimed responsibility for the murder of Taunja and others.

programme.title: Court Martial: Soldiers Behind Bars
programme.desc: A soldier faces up to his relationship with alcohol after being caught drunk on duty.

programme.title: Nurses Who Kill

programme.title: Crimes That Made History
programme.desc: In August 1933, Violette Nozière, 18, killed her father by poisoning in Paris. After a short period on the run, she was charged with murder and swiftly confessed to the crime, saying her motive was that he abused her. The press and public were immediately fascinated by this patricidal teenager, who became known as "the monster in the skirt".

programme.title: Crimes That Made History
programme.desc: On May 18th 1936, Abe Sada killed her lover by "erotic asphyxia" then cut off his member and carved his name in her flesh. In a militarized Japan, the press was very interested in this crime with erotic and transgressive accents. The murder has become a classic in Japanese culture; news of this crime spread a made up image of Japan - where love and sexual urges are liberated - to the West.
programme.sub-title: Abe Sada: The Fantasy of Japanese Eroticism (1936)

This documentary offers an extraordinary civilian perspective, intertwining anonymous lives with the unfolding tragedy and liberation of WWII.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis

A collapsing order gives way to a brutal, modern conflict.

programme.title: The Crusade in the Pacific
programme.desc: An in-depth look at the air war over Japan during WWII, including the Doolittle Raid, B-29 attacks, and the nuclear bombings of Hiroshima and Nagasaki.

programme.title: Naval Warfare in World War II
programme.desc: The Japanese fleet is disintegrating, and the Imperial Navy conducts its last major operation in the Philippines. It ends in debacle: The risen battleships of Pearl Harbor avenge the attack in Surigao Strait, the Center Force is defeated in Sibuyan Sea, the jeep carriers and destroyers fend off a stronger Japanese force near Samar and the remaining Japanese aircraft carriers are sunk.

programme.title: Decisive Battles of Hitler's War
programme.desc: In November 1943 at the Tehran Conference, Churchill agreed to an offensive that would once again bring his British forces to full scale combat with the Nazis. Allied Supreme Commander Dwight D. Eisenhower arrived in London in January 1944 for final planning. The obvious route to France was heavily defended and lacked a major port. The only feasible alternative were the beaches of Normandy.
programme.sub-title: Decisive Battles of Hitler's War: Normandy to the Rhine

programme.title: Embedded 45' Shooting War in Germany
programme.desc: This second episode covers the last week of March to late April. When American troops started their final invasion of Nazi Germany in February 1945, U.S. Army cameramen were at their side. Over a thousand reels have been preserved; many of them untouched for decades. The cameramen covered many stories of victory and defeat, death and liberation. Faces of despair and joy, scenes of war and peace.

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: Faith conquers fear. Caught behind enemy lines with their Paratroop Battalion, Chaplain Francis Sampson and Medic Fred Banners tend to their wounded unit. But paralyzed by fear of the barrage of shells, Banners is more trouble than help. The Chaplain's faith comes into full force, insisting to remain with the wounded while his unit retreats. Witnessing true faith, the Medic Banners goes to work.

programme.title: WWII: On the Edge of the Abyss
programme.desc: In August 1945, the world witnesses the devastating impact of atomic warfare as Hiroshima and Nagasaki are obliterated. This episode chronicles Japan's last stand, the internal debates within its leadership, and the toll of civilian suffering. The stage is set for the end of the war, as Emperor Hirohito faces the inevitable.

programme.title: The War In Burma
programme.desc: This military film documents the War in Burma in the South-East Asian theater of World War II.

programme.title: WWII: The Road To Victory
programme.desc: This episode chronicles the Battle of The Bulge and how our forces struck back and defeated Hitler's last stand.

programme.title: Complete History of Air Combat
programme.desc: For much of WWII, the German Luftwaffe was virtually indestructible, churning out planes at a rate of one every quarter-hour. By 1944, the Allies turned the tide. The 'Big Week' kicked off on February 20, 1944.

programme.title: WWII: The Road To Victory
programme.desc: In our Island Hopping campaigns during WW2, the operation against the Japanese held on the Gilbert Islands began on the 20th of November, 1943. The fight on Tarawa and Makin will be discussed.

programme.title: War in the Pacific
programme.desc: The first marine division captures Guadalcanal.

programme.title: Nazi War Criminals
programme.desc: This film permanently and accurately documents the trial of the Nazi defendants at Nuremberg. It includes German footage of Nazi personalities and activities interwoven with film shot during the trials. It follows the story of the rise and fall of Nazism from the putsch in a Munich beer hall to the Nuremberg trials, and contains flashbacks of a variety of Nazi crimes against humanity.

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: Pee Wee Donovan became a first aid man after promising his mother he wouldn't hurt anyone. Amidst the chaos of mortar and machine gun fire during the 1944 Battle of Hurtgen Forest, he and another aid carried a severely injured soldier through enemy territory. Faced with danger, Pee Wee forgot his promise and fought bravely, leading to heroic moments that create a thrilling and heartwarming story.

programme.title: Hunting Down The Nazis
programme.desc: Simon Wiesenthal, a survivor of the death camps, is hunting down his torturers, from the camp Kapos to Mengele, the mad doctor of Auschwitz. Lawyer and historian Serge Klarsfeld, whose father was deported and murdered, has devoted his life to searching for Nazi leaders still at large. For the first time a film recounts the story of the long pursuit of Nazis in hiding, from 1945 to the present day.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour

programme.title: The Millionaires' Holiday Club
programme.desc: Since selling her business twelve years ago, Jane decided to retire with partner Michael and spend the rest of her days on holiday; this year's first holiday, the couple went on twelve last year, begins with a sumptuous Christmas cruise around the Caribbean islands; from haute couture dress shopping to partying hard at the Champagne Splash, the cruise's legendary champagne and caviar party on the beach, Jane's as determined as ever to never grow old gracefully.

programme.desc: On the next step of our curing a smoking journey, Steve introduces us to the process of making salami. Steve also hot smokes some fresh cuts of mackerel, while Tim Maddams reveals how to quick smoke rabbit.
programme.sub-title: Smoking and Curing: Salami and Smoking

programme.title: River Cottage Bites Extended Version
programme.desc: Whether it's sugar or spice that excites you, Pam Corbin and Gill Meller have you covered by showing you how to bake a memorable cardamom and orange cake, as well as a Yorkshire parkin. They also bake jammy dodgers and wild garlic muffins.
programme.sub-title: Cake Bites: Sugar and Spice, Family Favorites

programme.title: River Cottage Bites Extended Version
programme.desc: Beginning with the basics, John Wright takes you through his step-by-step process for producing bottles of hardy apple cider you can share with your family and friends. He also shows you how to create the perfect Parfait Amour cocktail.
programme.sub-title: Booze Bites: Cider and Parfait Amour

programme.title: River Cottage Bites Extended Version
programme.desc: Curing can be a fantastic way to bring fresh new flavors to fish, and Tim Maddams shows you how by preparing salt pollack fritters and a fennel cured mackerel. Steve Lamb prepares rose cured beef utilizing the hot smoking method.
programme.sub-title: Smoking and Curing: Fish and Beef

programme.title: Ross Kemp: Deep Sea Treasure Hunter
programme.desc: Ross hunts for wrecks that add to the story of D-Day and discovers how the road to victory required ingenuity. He learns about Operation Smash and dives a Valentine tank that could float. He also explores the LST 523, a massive cargo ship.

programme.title: Ross Kemp: Shipwreck Treasure Hunter
programme.desc: Inspired by a family story, Ross travels to Scapa Flow in the Orkney Islands to explore the F2, a captured German scout warship whose contents might provide a link to his relatives. Ross also dives the SS Tabarka, a Royal Navy freighter.

programme.title: Secrets of the National Parks
programme.desc: Hawaii Volcanoes and Haleakala National Parks are two of the most extraordinary places on Earth. Here you can witness molten lava bubbling from the earth, catch a spectacular sunrise above the cloud-line, or take a dip into pools of paradise.

programme.title: Inside America's National Parks
programme.desc: Experience the grandeur and supreme spectacle of the Grand Canyon. This insider's view of one of the world's greatest natural wonders takes you rim-to-rim to hike hidden canyons, plunge into ancient pools, raft world-class rapids, discover manmade gems, and explore extreme backcountry. In the end, you will agree, the Grand Canyon is much more than 'grand.' It is sacred.

programme.title: Bare Feet with Mickela Mallozzi
programme.desc: The Bronx is not only known as the Borough of Salsa, it is also known as the Borough of Music. Follow Mickela as she delves into the longstanding Puerto Rican musical style whose influence stretches across New York City.

programme.title: Bare Feet with Mickela Mallozzi
programme.desc: From Israeli folk dance at the 92Y to eating knishes in the Lower East Side, Mickela spends some quality time getting to know one of New York's most cultural and religiously pious populations.

programme.title: Bare Feet with Mickela Mallozzi
programme.desc: The Republic of Georgia in The Caucasus is a land of wine, unrivaled hospitality, and Polyphonic singing. In the capital city of Tbilisi, Mickela dances with the Sukhishvili Georgian National Ballet, as well as the folkloric group Zedashe.

programme.title: Bare Feet with Mickela Mallozzi
programme.desc: Mickela jumps right in with the locals for dancing, music, and the building of Castells in Girona, Catalonia during the Feast of Saint John. She also visits Palamos to learn the iconic Sardana dance and celebrate the Habaneras Festival.

programme.title: Bare Feet with Mickela Mallozzi
programme.desc: Cyprus is an ancient island full of mythology and festive dancing. Mickela discovers the rich tapestry of Greek culture here by taking part in belly dancing, meeting silversmiths and lace artisans, and celebrating the Kataklysmos Festival.

programme.title: Bare Feet with Mickela Mallozzi
programme.desc: In Bucharest, Romania Mickela dances in the villages of Bucovina, then heads to Transylvania to learn the traditional Calusarii dance. She meets with local artisans and is taken in as one of the family in the village of Clejani.

programme.title: River Cottage Bites Extended Version
programme.desc: To plan a vegetable garden Mark focuses on the flavors he wants in his dishes, and the culinary preparations he wishes to serve to family and friends. Having properly planned for his vegetable garden, it is time to get down to business.
programme.sub-title: Veg Bites: Planning, Sowing and Planting

programme.sub-title: Cake Bites: Zest and Zing, Afternoon Tea

programme.title: River Cottage Bites Extended Version
programme.desc: Thankfully, the main threats to your vegetable garden are reasonably predictable, easy to identify, and few in number. Mark's tips will help you get the most out of your garden and instill within you the idea that you can garden anywhere.
programme.sub-title: Veg Bites: Pest Control and Garden Tips

programme.title: Exploring Mexico's Kitchen with Rick Bayless
programme.desc: Jammed with a harmonious balance of dried chiles, nuts, seeds, dried fruit, and chocolate, this mole poblano can be ready in about an hour's time, or more, if you want to let the pot simmer awhile. The key to success is preparation.

programme.title: Secrets of the National Parks
programme.desc: By foot, shuttle, and horseback, gain access to the scenic and geological wonders of Zion and Bryce Canyon National Parks. In Zion, embark on a breathtaking ascent of Angel's Landing. In Bryce, climb sheer cliff walls, tubs down the Virgin River, and gaze upon thousands of beautiful bizarre rock spires known as hoodoos.

programme.title: Secrets of the National Parks
programme.desc: Discover the many ways to experience high adventure in "the land of shining mountains." Take an unforgettable hike along the Highline Trail, raft a wild river, or travel by train aboard the renowned Empire Builder. Behold massive glaciers, and get close (but not too close!) to bears. Then, kick back at a high-altitude chalet.
programme.sub-title: The Secrets of Glacier National Park

programme.title: Bare Feet with Mickela Mallozzi
programme.desc: Music and dance are core attributes of Ireland's culture. Mickela learns the Riverdance step in Dublin, and the penny whistle at Gus O'Connor's Pub in Doolin. She also attends a matchmaking festival, and Ireland's oldest weekly set dances.

programme.title: Bare Feet with Mickela Mallozzi
programme.desc: Beginning in the awe-inspiring Dingle Peninsula, Mickela dances with David Geaney, goes on a walking food tour of Dingle, sits in on a trad session with SuperCeili at The Dingle Music Shop, and is then taught the brush dance in Killarney.

programme.title: Bare Feet with Mickela Mallozzi
programme.desc: The passionate dance and music of flamenco envelopes their world as Mickela soaks in Seville, Spain. First, Mickela dines at one of the oldest tapas bars in Seville before receiving instruction from legendary dancer, Cristina Hoyos.

programme.title: Bare Feet with Mickela Mallozzi

Former mall security guard Doughy (Tom Arnold) shows up to protect the teenage population, but he's clearly not much help, allowing the murderer to pick off even more hapless kids as numerous scary movies are referenced.

As it turns out, his father (Sigourney Weaver) is not a cultural attache but a spy, and Will is in over his head. He must find a way to turn the tables on his enemies, or he and his family will all die.

He sets out to try to find a shard of the dark crystal, a powerful gem that once provided balance to the universe. After the crystal was broken, the evil Skeksis used sinister means to gain control. Jen believes that he can repair the dark crystal and bring peace back to the world, if he can only find the remaining shard.

She's shocked, however, when she discovers that her politician boyfriend (Booker Bradshaw) is involved.

programme.desc: Edina (Jennifer Saunders) decides finding the perfect handle for her kitchen door will help organize her life.

Bent on revenge, Patchett begins an intricate undertaking that will lead to the destruction of all that Bob holds dear -- and she also has plans for Fisher while she's at it.

So when her car and corpse are discovered in the Hudson River, police Chief Wyatt Rash (Danny DeVito) immediately suspects murder rather than an accident. Their plans for fun soon give way to terror when members of a violent biker gang invade the peaceful countryside. Dekker's final job, however, proves to be trickier than expected when the sadistic Zidzyck (Lewis Smith) recruits the assassin to kill his wife, Jain (Sherilyn Fenn), along with the couple's baby. While Dekker has a change of heart and resolves not to shoot Jain and her child, his decision places all their lives in danger, since Zidzyck has dispatched another killer to perform the task.

Desperate to instill discipline, Chappy hires as an instructor his former protégé, Doug Masters (Jason Cadieux), who had previously been shot down by the Soviets. programme.desc: An ambitious African-American law student returns home for Christmas with her boyfriend. The family is unsettled because the boyfriend is white.

Nighttime is approaching, and President El Bama (George Lopez) announces that the annual purge is about to begin. Carl and his loved ones must now endure a 12-hour period of lawlessness before they can enjoy life once again.

Starletta (Wendy Raquel Robinson), her boyfriend, Demond (Michael Jai White), and the three women he's been cheating on her with also arrive for the episode. Soon, shameless Demond starts chasing after Angel.

45365 explores the congruities of daily life in an American town. From the patrol car to the courtroom, the playground to the nursing home, the parade to the prayer service, it explores relationships and interactions - with people and their environment. The stories of a father and son, a young relationship, cops and criminals, officials and their electorate coalesce into a mosaic of faces, places, and events. 45365 is a portrait of a city and its people. Directed by Turner Ross and Bill Ross IV.

programme.desc: Nicola is a natural winemaker living in a remote village near Crotone, where his atavistic pursuit of wine is under active siege from climate related wildfires and the prolonged dry seasons. "Wildfire" patiently observes Nicola in this affective state of anxiety-as the wildfire grows within him-as he's forced to alter the course of his harvest in real time.

Itto is asked by the vassals of the Maruoka clan, whose feudal lord has been assassinated and the clan destroyed, to kill their underling, the official assassin Gunpei Yagyu (Katsuhiko Watahiki). Gunbei is the son of Retsudo Yagyu (Rentaro Mikuni), the chieftain of the Yagyu underlings.

programme.title: Return of the Chinese Boxer

They form an alliance with General Tao, a major power broker in the kingdom, prompting other Chinese generals to rally against him.

programme.title: Iron Monkey

programme.title: Dragon Squad
programme.desc: When a case of gold is stolen in transit, the surviving member of an escort party, Sung (Kam Kong) tries to recover it. He initially turns to Master Wu (Chen Sing) who unfortunately develops a drinking problem after he gets out of prison for accidentally killing someone. He has felt guilty ever since. Wu S friend Hung (Chang Yi) decides to help Sung and enlists a con man, Sau Pau (Jimmy Wang Yu), who has come upon some evidence.

programme.title: Ninja the Protector

Ninja secret agent John Hart has to infiltrate the gang and rescue an undercover cop before he can take on the leader of the Forgery Gang, Fo, whose skills in this ancient art of ninja are equally matched.

programme.title: Duel in the Desert

programme.title: Ebenezer the Traveler
programme.desc: Following the merriest Christmas day of Ebenezer Scrooge's long and miserable life, the day after finds him much less merry, and instead much more dead. Reunited with his old partner Jacob Marley, a no longer quite so Tiny Tim, and his beloved sister Fan, together they are tasked with earning their own redemptions, and regaining Scrooge's second chance, by crossing over time and the mortal plane to help guide others who are in danger of losing their way.

programme.title: Dear Santa
programme.desc: A young woman who comes from a life of privilege falls for the owner of a soup kitchen after discovering a Dear Santa letter written by his seven year old daughter.

programme.title: Holiday Engagement
programme.desc: Jilted by her high-powered fiancé just before Thanksgiving, and terrified of disappointing her mother, Hillary Burns hires an unemployed artist to pretend to be her fiancé.

programme.title: Christmas Collision
programme.desc: A time-consumed professional crosses paths with a writer when she travels to his hometown for business just before Christmas. Unexpected circumstances bring them together, and sparks fly between the two.

programme.title: London Mitchell's Christmas
programme.desc: London Mitchell who is known as a Scrooge has previously lived an unscrupulous lifestyle, by divorcing his wife, barely seeing his children, and dumping a woman a month before Christmas to be with somebody else.

programme.title: 12 Days of Christmas
programme.desc: Childhood best friends Amy (Annie Newton) and Steve (Drew Petriello) return home from their first semester of college for what they hope will be a relaxed winter break. However, when a night of heavy drinking blurs the boundaries of their friendship, Amy and Steve find themselves dealing with a most unexpected holiday surprise: an unplanned pregnancy.

programme.title: A Christmas in New York
programme.desc: In the vein of Love Actually, the story follows six different couples in a posh Manhattan hotel over the course of one night just before Christmas.

programme.title: My Dad's Christmas Date
programme.desc: It's Christmas and the charming city of York, home to Jules, 16 and her Dad, David is decked out ready for the festive season. In many ways, David and Jules' relationship is no different from that of most fathers and their sixteen-year-old daughters. He struggles to understand her, she refuses to communicate with him. He wants to be involved in her life, she wants her own space.

programme.title: I'll Be Homeless For Christmas
programme.desc: When a petty thief learns that his latest mark is a struggling single mother who works at a homeless shelter, he decides to use his savvy street smarts to make this Christmas one to remember for her and her young son.

programme.title: Cupid's Christmas
programme.desc: As Santa Claus searches for his lost Reindeer (Cupid) in the small town of Holly; the love story of Katie Valentine and Army veteran/firefighter Luke Murphy is re-ignited during an effort to save the historic town train depot by raising the funds necessary for its restoration and renovation. All the while, Katie's young niece Olivia goes on a mission to prove to her family that Santa Claus is real and the reindeer seen around town really is Cupid a member of Santa's sleigh team.

programme.title: Feather Christmas
programme.desc: When an ailing pet chicken arrives at Martin's animal sanctuary over the holidays, his family's festive plans are turned upside down.

programme.title: Falling for Christmas
programme.desc: When champion figure skater Claire becomes injured she is sent to a rehabilitation center in the snowy mountains where she meets and falls for a local ice fisherman who shows her there is more to life than competition.

programme.title: Auld Lang Syne
programme.desc: Two broke, out-of-work actresses in their sixties hide out on a film set so they can have their dream Christmas.

programme.title: Christmas Crush
programme.desc: When a woman learns of her high school reunion a week before Christmas, she's ecstatic to finally have her chance to win back the one that got away.

programme.title: Santa Fake
programme.desc: A young man from Ireland emigrates to the United States and finds himself caught up in an escalating whirlwind of shenanigans.

programme.title: Christmas Freak
programme.desc: Rudy celebrates Christmas every single day. He's a uncool Christmas Freak with no friends. A sassy angel helps Rudy discover there is more to life than Christmas.

programme.title: Christmas in the Heartland
programme.desc: Teenagers Kara and Jessie strike up an unlikely friendship while sitting next to each other on a plane that's bound for the heartland. Forced to spend the holidays in the same small town with relatives that they've never met, the girls devise a plan to switch places for Christmas. Jessie soon finds herself living lavishly with Kara's wealthy grandparents, while Kara starts to bond with Jessie's fun, quirky grandmother and the most genuine, modest family that she's ever known.

programme.title: Holiday Engagement
programme.desc: Jilted by her high-powered fiancé just before Thanksgiving, and terrified of disappointing her mother, Hillary Burns hires an unemployed artist to pretend to be her fiancé.

programme.title: My Dad's Christmas Date
programme.desc: It's Christmas and the charming city of York, home to Jules, 16 and her Dad, David is decked out ready for the festive season. In many ways, David and Jules' relationship is no different from that of most fathers and their sixteen-year-old daughters. He struggles to understand her, she refuses to communicate with him. He wants to be involved in her life, she wants her own space.

programme.title: Christmas Survival
programme.desc: Sisters, Miranda (Gemma Whelan, "Game of Thrones"), Lyla (Joely Richardson) and their families, come together for Christmas in this heart-warming holiday comedy. Over the span of three days chaos and hilarity wreak havoc on the family's holiday plans and ancient sibling rivalries flare-up to sabotage the hope for a season of good will and yuletide fun.

programme.title: Alex & the List
